critical_code_review_comments: revenue_service.list_admin_settlements/list_settlements always calls ensure_recent_settlements() which triggers apply_overdue_suspensions() on every read — fine functionally but could add DB write pressure on hot endpoints; consider throttling to once/minute.
settlement.py update_template has dead line `patch['columns'] = [c if isinstance(c, dict) else c for c in patch['columns']]` (identity comprehension, no-op) — cosmetic cleanup.

bank_template_service._beneficiary_details silently returns empty strings when admin has no bank account; UI already surfaces 'no bank' in payout-admins-table which is good, but the CSV export will still emit blank account/IFSC rows without an error — consider a 400 if any selected beneficiary has no bank on file.
